data.user_prompt: How much does it cost to hire a company to build an AI agent, and which firms offer this service?

sections.text:
Hiring a company to build an AI agent typically costs **$5,000–$150,000+**, depending on complexity. A production-grade enterprise system can exceed **$300,000–$500,000**, while simpler managed agents may start near **$1,000 plus $200/month** for hosting and maintenance.[1][3][6]

## Typical cost ranges

| Project type | Typical one-time cost |
|---|---:|
| Simple FAQ, chatbot, or single-task agent | $5,000–$15,000 |
| Agent connected to several business tools | $15,000–$50,000 |
| Agent with memory, RAG, testing, and multiple workflows | $40,000–$120,000 |
| Regulated, highly integrated, or multi-agent system | $100,000–$500,000+ |
| Enterprise-wide agent platform | $300,000–$800,000+ |

These figures generally exclude ongoing model usage, cloud hosting, monitoring, maintenance, and support. Operating costs commonly range from **$500–$5,000+ per month** for smaller systems, while larger deployments can cost **$40,000–$120,000 annually** or more.[3][6]

## Companies that offer AI-agent development

Potential vendors include:

- **Accenture, Deloitte Digital, Infosys, and Booz Allen Hamilton** — large enterprise, government, and regulated-industry deployments; reported project minimums commonly start in the hundreds of thousands of dollars.[8]
- **Moveworks** — enterprise internal-support and workflow automation agents, generally sold as tailored packages or annual SaaS contracts.[2][8]
- **LeewayHertz, DEVCOM, JADA Squad, Neurons Lab, and Winder.AI** — custom agents, integrations, and enterprise implementations.[2]
- **EnactOn, Simform, Qubika, Markovate, Azumo, Softermii, HyperSense Software, Trigma, and NineTwoThree** — custom development for startups and mid-market companies, with reported minimum projects ranging from roughly $5,000 to $100,000.[3]
- **Space-O Technologies, Intuz, WiserBrand, Trigent, Plavno, EffectiveSoft, N-iX, and Instinctools** — development firms listed with hourly rates from about $25 to $149 and minimum projects from $5,000 to $100,000.[6]
- **LuMay and VantaSoft** — lower-cost managed or packaged offerings; LuMay lists agents from $249/month and custom pilots from $25,000, while VantaSoft reports builds starting at $1,000 and ongoing service from $200/month.[1][2]
- **LOW/CODE Agency, 10Pearls, Wizeline, Thoughtful AI, WillowTree, Turing, and Toptal** — mid-market development, staff augmentation, and specialized engineering services.[8]

## What determines the price

The largest cost drivers are:

- Number of tools and systems the agent must access
- Whether it only answers questions or can take actions
- Use of company documents, databases, or private customer data
- Memory, retrieval-augmented generation, evaluation, and guardrails
- Voice, telephony, or real-time interaction
- Security, compliance, auditability, and human approval workflows
- Expected usage volume and required uptime
- Ongoing monitoring, model updates, and maintenance

For most small and midsize businesses, a realistic initial budget is **$15,000–$75,000** for a useful first production version, plus recurring infrastructure and support costs. A fixed-price proposal should clearly separate **discovery, development, integrations, deployment, and ongoing operating expenses**.
